Drop a video file named hero-placeholder.mp4 into the public/ folder of this project to display it on the homepage.

How to use:
1. Find your video file (mp4 recommended for broad browser support).
2. Rename it to hero-placeholder.mp4
3. Place it inside this folder (the public/ directory of the project).
4. The homepage video player will load it automatically at the URL "/hero-placeholder.mp4".

Optional:
- A poster frame: place hero-poster.jpg in this same folder if you want a still image before the video plays.

Notes:
- File should be reasonably small (ideally under 10MB) for fast page load.
- Recommended resolution: 1920x1080 or smaller, H.264 encoded.
